title: SG-6.3 · Render ExecutionPanel in AdminApp with the loaded execution
summary: AdminApp shows ExecutionPanel fed by the loaded contributions and execution
description: Context: AdminApp (game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx) already loads the round, contributions and the current Round's execution (state `execution`, `contributions`), and renders LifecycleStepper. ExecutionPanel (game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx) exists but is not rendered. Desired behavior: AdminApp renders ExecutionPanel showing contribution count, duration, agent logs, test results, release version and failure reason from the loaded execution. Expected result: the admin sees these values on the admin page, covered by a unit test. Why: the admin needs to monitor the Worker execution.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded execution and contributions, when AdminApp renders, then ExecutionPanel shows the contribution count, duration, agent logs, test results, release version and failure reason
Given no execution for the round, when AdminApp renders, then ExecutionPanel shows 'Not available' placeholders and the correct contribution count
A unit test with mocked fetch asserts the rendered panel values

in_scope: Unit test for AdminApp rendering ExecutionPanel

technical_constraints: Frontend only; no new API calls
Reuse existing ExecutionInfo state in AdminApp
